note: Track pitch (voice-pitch), step 5: a slow slide from the low Do to the high Do and back over a drone, then the same two notes as one leap. Rewritten from the plan exercise (ChoiceSplit3): what to sing on has its own sentence, the leap has a feel to reach (it lands where the slide ended), the octave comes back in other keys as a move (any key) with a line on what stays the same, and the top note has a care line.

exercise.title: Slide to the high Do
exercise.why: A slow slide passes through every pitch between two notes, so it shows your voice the whole distance before you leap it.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below to start the drone and the mic. Slide slowly from the low {{1}} up to the high {{1}} and back, like a siren, and watch your line pass {{5}} on the way. Sing it on "oo".
Then sing the two notes as one clean leap, until the high {{1}} lands where the slide ended.
In another key the slide starts on a new Do, and it is still one octave.
_Don't push for the high Do: keep it quiet, and turn the slide round where it gets tight._
